remarks: Welcome to 21 Hollow Tree Rd in Norwalk! ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED + ASSIGNED PARKING & WASHER/DRYER IN UNIT. Landlord has made PLENTY of upgrades to the space including painting, professionally cleaning, NEW kitchen appliances, NEW washer/dryer, NEW central air system (heat/a/c), NEWLY sanded & stained hardwood flooring throughout, NEW fixtures in bathroom & MORE! Private entrance on side/rear of home. Sit on your own balcony/deck & enjoy peace & serenity. Nature-filled perfect for relaxing all 4 seasons. Apartment includes 1 spacious bedroom (large closet), 1 full bathroom (stand-up shower), living room (plenty natural light) & EIK (all new appliances). Hardwood floors throughout, skylights & open concept for your comfort. Pull down attic for extra storage! Assigned parking in lot, guests park on quiet street. Plenty of cabinets/closets for storage. Tenant MUST have good credit, proof of income & references. **Due to utilities being INCLUDED, rent for 2 persons $2,500/month**
